# HyperOS Package Installer Mod **The HyperOS package installer with a new UI and none of the restrictions.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Package-Installer?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Package-Installer/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Package-Installer/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Package-Installer/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Package-Installer?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Package-Installer/stargazers) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-channel-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)
## Features - New UI that shows more information about the app being installed - System apps can be installed - No ads or pop-ups - HyperOS 4 support (base 5.5.4.0.0) ## Requirements - HyperOS - Magisk, KernelSU or APatch ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Package-Installer/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch. 3. Reboot your device. ## Notes - Some Global ROMs may bootloop with this module. Install at your own risk, and keep a way to remove modules from recovery. ## Screenshots

HyperOS Package Installer Mod

The HyperOS package installer with a new UI and none of the restrictions.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Package-Installer/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Package-Installer/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Package-Installer/stargazers)

![Telegram](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)

Features

  • New UI that shows more information about the app being installed
  • System apps can be installed
  • No ads or pop-ups
  • HyperOS 4 support (base 5.5.4.0.0)

    • Requirements

  • HyperOS
  • Magisk, KernelSU or APatch

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Package-Installer/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch.
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • Some Global ROMs may bootloop with this module. Install at your own risk, and keep a way to remove modules from recovery.

    • Screenshots
